make_quadruped_environment: build a python module to create a quadruped DMC environment using make with a specified task name like stand or escape
make_model_xml: build a python module to generate a quadruped MuJoCo model XML string with optional terrain and rangefinders via make_model
run_stand_task: run the Stand task class to train a quadruped agent to stay upright using upright reward
run_escape_task: run the Escape task class to train a quadruped agent to escape a bowl-shaped terrain with rangefinder observations
run_fetch_task: run the Fetch task class to train a quadruped agent to push a ball to a target position
